title: DW3 port partners/<key>/partner.json (partners-partner-v1)
description: One new partner of a content mod (the folder partners/<key>/ with partner.json beside its art: portrait.png, icon.png, field/, training/). Derived from pc/shim/partner_ext.c and content.c. A partner is <mod folder>:<key>; its index in the game is 8 plus its place in the alphabetical order of all declared partners. The partner.json the game exports for an original partner (data/partners/<name>/partner.json) uses the same format name but is descriptive and never read; a mod folder named like an original partner only replaces art.

name.description: Optional header: the folder's name, which is the partner's key (the partner is <mod folder>:<key>). A folder named like an original partner (the slug of its English name, e.g. agumon) is that partner's art folder and is never a new partner.

base.description: An original partner: its 2D art stands in for the new partner until it has its own, and its bit of every item's partners mask is the equipment eligibility unless equip.like says another.

firstForm.description: The form the partner starts as (its stats, growth and battle model). An original partner form or a new form of digimon.json.

title.description: The partner's name per language folder: eng, fra, ita, ger, spa, es-419 (es-419 falls back to spa, then eng). eng is required. It is called title because name is the header (the folder).

description.description: The starter screen's text for the partner (a few lines, \n between them). Optional.

equip.description: Equipment eligibility beyond the u8 mask the original items carry (a bit for each of the first eight partners).

like.description: The original partner whose mask bit it reads (default: base).

items.description: An item: its number, dw3:item/<id>, or <mod>:<key> of a new item.

allow.description: Items it can wear whatever the mask says.

items.description: An item: its number, dw3:item/<id>, or <mod>:<key> of a new item.

deny.description: Items it cannot wear (wins over allow and the mask).

equipSet.description: Four items worn together and what wearing them whole adds (EQUIP_SETS / EQUIP_SET_BONUSES).

items.description: An item: its number, dw3:item/<id>, or <mod>:<key> of a new item.

bonuses.description: Added to the six battle stats.

evolution.description: The forms the partner can learn after a battle: its evolution list (the Evolution struct, include/battle/report.h), first match wins, one per report.

digimon.description: A partner form: dw3:digimon/<id> of an original partner form, or <mod>:<key> of a form in digimon.json.

stat.description: 1-6 the battle stats, 7 level, 8-14 the resistances.

value.description: The least that stat must be (default 1 with a stat).
